records.text: Owens presented a diagram identifying five vehicles affiliated with Turning Point USA at the UVU event: a Jeep Wagoneer, a Lincoln Navigator, two Yukon Denalis, and a Hyundai Palisade.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Let's pull up a diagram. Okay, these are the cars. You will recall, obviously, we use AI here to demonstrate to you what the vehicles are here that turning point or that are affiliated with turning point USA. ... Let's start with the left side there. On the left hand side, you see two security vehicles. The one that's in front, the first one is a black Jeep Wagoneer. We'll just call that security vehicle number one. Alex Faria is in this vehicle. ... Anyway, going back to that back to the vehicle diagram. Okay, behind that Jeep Wagoneer, you have a Lincoln Navigator. ... Now, to the right of them, we have back-to-back Yukon Denalis. You, of course, know that one of the front is going to be the one that Charlie Kirk shows up in and that Charlie Kirk is going to depart in after he is hit with an explosive. ... He was driving me like an Uber driver. Who knows why? And then lastly, you have on the far right there, the Hyundai Palisade. I'm not sure who actually drove this, but I do know based on footage, we've examined it, that it's a TPUSA vehicle, and that kind of stays parked on the far right side.

records.text: Owens said footage established the Hyundai Palisade was a Turning Point USA vehicle, while saying she did not know who drove it.
